# Data Visualization
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
penguins
```


```{r}
# global mappings
ggplot(data = drop_na(penguins),
       aes(x = bill_length_mm, 
           y = flipper_length_mm)) +
  geom_point()

# local mappings
ggplot(data = drop_na(penguins)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = bill_length_mm, 
        y = flipper_length_mm)) 
```

# global mappings
```{r}
ggplot(data = drop_na(penguins),
       aes(x = bill_length_mm, 
           y = flipper_length_mm)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x)

ggplot(data = drop_na(penguins)) +
  geom_point(aes(x = bill_length_mm, 
                 y = flipper_length_mm))  +
  geom_smooth(aes(x = bill_length_mm, 
                  y = flipper_length_mm),
              method = "lm", formula = y ~ x)


model <- lm(flipper_length_mm ~ bill_length_mm,
            data = drop_na(penguins))
ggplot(data = drop_na(penguins),
       aes(x = bill_length_mm, 
           y = flipper_length_mm)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline(intercept = coef(model)[1],
              slope = coef(model)[2])
```

```{r}
# global mappings
ggplot(data = drop_na(penguins),
       aes(x = bill_length_mm, 
           y = flipper_length_mm,
           color = species)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = 'y ~ x')

# global and local mappings
ggplot(data = drop_na(penguins),
       aes(x = bill_length_mm, 
           y = flipper_length_mm)) +
  geom_point(size=3, aes(color = species)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm",
              color = "black", formula = 'y ~ x')
```

```{r}
# global mappings
ggplot(data = drop_na(penguins),
       aes(x = bill_length_mm, 
           y = flipper_length_mm,
           color = species)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = 'y ~ x') +
  geom_point(size = 3)

# global and local mappings
ggplot(data = drop_na(penguins),
       aes(x = bill_length_mm, 
           y = flipper_length_mm)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm",
              color = "black", formula = 'y ~ x') +
  geom_point(size=3, aes(color = species))
```

## Labels with ```labs()```\
```
labs(
  title = "...",
  subtitle = "...",
  x = "...",
  y = "..."
)
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = drop_na(penguins),
       mapping = aes(x = bill_length_mm, 
                     y = flipper_length_mm,
                     color = species)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Bill and flipper length",
    subtitle = "Positive relation",
    x = "Bill length (mm)",
    y = "Flipper length (mm)")
```

## Facets
```{r}
ggplot(data = drop_na(penguins),
       mapping = aes(x = bill_length_mm, y = flipper_length_mm, color = species)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~ species)

ggplot(data = drop_na(penguins),
       mapping = aes(x = bill_length_mm, y = flipper_length_mm, color = species)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~ species, nrow = 2)



ggplot(data = drop_na(penguins),
       mapping = aes(x = bill_length_mm, y = flipper_length_mm, color = species)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_grid(. ~ species)  # facet_grid(cols = vars(species))

ggplot(data = drop_na(penguins),
       mapping = aes(x = bill_length_mm, y = flipper_length_mm, color = species)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_grid(species ~ .)  # facet_grid(rows = vars(species))

ggplot(data = drop_na(penguins),
       mapping = aes(x = bill_length_mm, y = flipper_length_mm, color = species)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_grid(species ~ island)
```

## Theme
```{r}
ggplot(data = drop_na(penguins),
       mapping = aes(x = bill_length_mm, 
                     y = flipper_length_mm,
                     color = species)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_classic()
```


## Scale
```{r}
ggplot(data = drop_na(penguins),
       mapping = aes(x = bill_length_mm, 
                     y = flipper_length_mm,
                     color = species)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 60)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(160, 240))

ggplot(data = drop_na(penguins),
       mapping = aes(x = bill_length_mm, 
                     y = flipper_length_mm,
                     color = species)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("orange", "magenta", "turquoise"))


```

## Bonus
```{r}
big_males <- penguins |> 
  filter(sex == "male") |> 
  group_by(species) |> 
  slice_max(body_mass_g)
big_males

ggplot(
  data = filter(penguins, sex == "male"),
  aes(x = bill_length_mm,
      y = flipper_length_mm,
      color = species)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(
    data = big_males,
    size = 4) +
  theme_minimal()
```
